test_title: PYST 10: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 15th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: A sentence is provided in indirect speech. Choose the option that correctly expresses it in direct speech: The doctor said that she was recovering and would return soon.

options.text: She is recovering and will return soon, said the doctor.
I recover and return soon, the doctor said.
I was recovering and would return soon, she said.
I am recovering and I return now, she said.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** The doctor said that she was recovering and would return soon.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"she was recovering and would return" becomes "She is recovering and will return"**
 
 
• Verb "was recovering" is converted to present tense "is recovering" for direct speech.
 
• Verb "would return" is changed to "will return" for future tense.
 
 
 
• **Reporting verb:**
 
 
• Indirect: "The doctor said"
 
• Converted to: "said the doctor" in direct speech format.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is enclosed in quotation marks.
 
• Starts with a capital letter "She" and ends with a period "."
 
• Reporting clause follows the quoted speech, starting with a lowercase letter after the comma.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"“She is recovering and will return soon,” said the doctor."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** "I recover and return soon," the doctor said."
 
 
• Pronoun "I" incorrectly used instead of "She," altering the subject.
 
• Tense "recover and return" is incorrect as it changes the meaning.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "I was recovering and would return soon," she said."
 
 
• Pronoun "I" incorrectly used instead of "She," altering the subject.
 
• Tense remains in indirect speech format instead of being converted.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "I am recovering and I return now," she said."
 
 
• Tense "I return now" is incorrect and changes the original meaning.
